claims.quote: KCNT2 was recently recognized as a gene associated with neurodevelopmental disorder and epilepsy.
Whole exome sequencing identified the missense variant c.725C > A p.(Thr242Asn)

claims.object_text: refractory stereotyped and monomorphic type of hyperkinetic focal motor seizure occurring only during sleep
claims.quote: Our patient has a refractory stereotyped and monomorphic type of hyperkinetic focal motor seizure, similar to what is seen in frontal lobe epilepsy, occurring only during sleep.
